megatron.forward_callsite: TransformerLayer._forward_attention self_attn_bda produces post-add hidden_states; TransformerLayer._forward_mlp then calls _forward_pre_mlp_layernorm and consumes its optional (normalized, residual) tuple
megatron.backward_relevance: The fused boundary must preserve gradients to the attention output, bias, incoming residual, and RMSNorm weight; training dropout must use the unchanged RNG semantics.
megatron.graph_pattern: attention output + optional bias -> dropout(training) -> residual add -> pre-MLP RMSNorm; return normalized output plus the post-add residual needed after MLP

tensor_contract.layout: H-last; exact strides captured at self_attn_bda and pre_mlp_layernorm boundaries
tensor_contract.training_inference_distinction: Training must preserve bias/dropout/add RNG and backward semantics; a dropout-zero inference specialization is a distinct declared variant.

distributed_context.sequence_parallel: local S partition must be accepted

replacement_boundary.replace: the declared self-attention BDA -> pre-MLP RMSNorm bridge, producing both normalized output and the post-add residual; TEFusedResidualRMSNorm alone only forks residual plus norm and is not proof that residual add was fused
replacement_boundary.fallback_detection: assert the bridge invocation marker and both output identities; reject unsupported dropout/dtype/stride combinations instead of falling back
